scientific_integrity: The contribution is an explicit whole-configuration stationary coupling and a simultaneous square-root-noise arcsine-Gaussian prediction law; existing star reduction, PDMP stationary formulas and general moment methods are credited. Proof uses graphical coalescence and conditional binomial limits; finite computations are supporting checks only.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted stationary star only; total-variation approximation proved for diverging reset rate much larger than log(number of leaves); bound is not optimality claim. No fixed-noise novelty, general-graph extension or Bayesian optimality claim; historical priority and independent audit remain open.
title: An arcsine–Gaussian majority-reconstruction crossover for high-noise voter stars
